evals.name: fresh_ai_os_onboarding
evals.prompt: I want to build a personal AI OS from scratch to manage my consulting work, study goals, and daily life. How should I set this up?
evals.expected_output: Agent initiates discovery interview, audits target directory, presents the 5 Core Life Hubs (Brainstorm with auto-routing, Career, Learnings, Other Activities, Personal), recommends Google Workspace MCP, installs all Anthropic skills, and enforces strict honesty non-negotiables.
assertions: Mentions the 5 Core Life Hubs: Brainstorm, Career, Learnings, Other Activities, and Personal
Recommends Google Workspace MCP for connecting 5 universal data domains
Confirms installation of all Anthropic skills from github.com/anthropics/skills.git
Enforces radical intellectual honesty and no sycophancy

evals.name: existing_workspace_adaptation
evals.prompt: I already have some project folders and notes in my directory. Can you turn this into a compounding AI OS without breaking my stuff?
evals.expected_output: Agent scans existing folders first, maps them non-destructively to the 5 Core Life Hubs, introduces Brainstorm routing, AGENTS.md single source of truth, and baseline Four-Cs health score.
assertions: Performs pre-flight scan of existing folders
Preserves existing files without destructive overwrites
Maps existing folders to the 5 core hubs
Creates canonical AGENTS.md with pointer files
